unitTitle: On Top of the World - Episode 2: The Rescue
scanNote:
3-HIKOYa 2-EPIZOD MAShQLARI (113-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'On Top of the World-Episode 2'.

CHAP USTUN:
1) 'Look at the pictures on p. 112, then read the questions and circle the correct answer.' 1 What is coming out of the engine? a fire b smoke. 2 What is the weather like? a warm and sunny b freezing cold. 3 What is about to attack Sandra? a an Arctic fox b a polar bear. 4 Who saves Sandra? a two explorers b three explorers. 5 What are they riding? a dogsleds b snowmobiles.
2) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to the episode and correct the words in bold.' 1 "There's a lot of WATER coming out of the engine!" 2 "We have to find a way to keep HOT!" 3 "Yes, but our TV isn't working." 4 "We're on our way to the research STOP."
3) 'Read the episode and answer the questions.' 1 Why should Tony, Sandra and David get out of the plane quickly? 2 What does the polar bear look like? 3 What scares the polar bear away? 4 How do the explorers find Tony, Sandra and David? 5 How will they all go to the research station?
4) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to the episode, then take roles and read it out.'
5) 'Read the list of events from both episodes of the story and put them in the correct order, then retell the story.' Kataklar: ☐ They land on the ice. ☐ They hop onto the snowmobiles. ☐ Two explorers scare the bear away. ☐ They start making a tent. ☐ The plane's engine stops. ☐ A polar bear comes close. ☑1 Sandra and David meet Tony. ☐ They leave with the explorers. ☐ They get out of the plane. ☐ They take off in the plane.

O'NG USTUN:
6) 'Fill in the answers to find out what scared the polar bear away.' KROSSVORD (vertikal yashirin so'z): 1 The two men are riding ...... . 2 The two men are ...... . 3 The plane's ...... stops. 4 Sandra hears a loud ...... as she is looking at the bear. 5 Tony says they need to make a ...... to keep warm. 6 Tony calls out ...... on the radio. 7 A polar ...... scares Sandra. 8 ...... comes out of the engine. 9 There are ...... in Greenland. 10 The ...... stops working.
7) 'Read the text and put the verbs into the correct tense, either in the active or the passive.' YaShIL QUTI (Grenlandiya surati): 'Greenland, called Kallaalit Nunaat in the Inuit language, is the largest island in the world and the closest piece of land to the North Pole. Much of it is above the Arctic Circle, where the sun 1) ...... (not/set) at all during the summer. Greenland 2) ...... (discover) by Erik the Red, a Viking from Iceland, in 982 AD. He 3) ...... (call) it "Greenland" in order to make other people want to go there. Greenland 4) ...... (have) a very cold climate, with heavy snowstorms and winter temperatures as low as minus 35°C. Even in summer, the temperature in the north only 5) ...... (reach) 3 - 4°C. Greenland 6) ...... (have) almost no trees or grass, and very few species of animals can be found there, although seals and whales are common in the seas around the island. An enormous ice cap 7) ...... (cover) nearly 85% of the island. In some places, the sheet of ice is more than 3 kilometres thick. Melting ice forms glaciers around the edges of the ice cap. In recent years, however, scientists 8) ...... (notice) that the glaciers 9) ...... (melt) much faster than expected. If the melting 10) ...... (continue) so quickly, it could cause the level of the world's oceans to rise, and produce a global environmental disaster.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '113'.

items.en: 1 Why should Tony, Sandra and David get out of the plane quickly?
items.uz: 1 Tony, Sandra va David nega samolyotdan tez chiqishi kerak?
items.answerEn: Because there's a lot of smoke coming out of the engine.

items.en: 2 What does the polar bear look like?
items.answerEn: It is huge and white, and it is standing on its back legs.
items.answerUz: U ulkan va oq, orqa oyoqlarida turibdi.

items.en: 3 What scares the polar bear away?
items.answerEn: A loud bang from the explorers' special noisemakers.
items.answerUz: Sayyohlarning maxsus shovqin chiqargichlaridan chiqqan qattiq portlash ovozi.

items.en: 4 How do the explorers find Tony, Sandra and David?
items.uz: 4 Sayyohlar Tony, Sandra va Davidni qanday topadi?
items.answerEn: They see the smoke from the plane's engine and come to see what it is.
items.answerUz: Ular samolyot dvigatelidan chiqqan tutunni ko'radi va bu nima ekanini ko'rgani keladi.

items.en: 5 How will they all go to the research station?
items.uz: 5 Ular hammasi tadqiqot stansiyasiga qanday boradi?

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1 Sandra and David meet Tony.
  2 They take off in the plane.
  3 The plane's engine stops.
  4 They land on the ice.
  5 They get out of the plane.
  6 They start making a tent.
  7 A polar bear comes close.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and put the verbs into the correct tense, either in the active or the passive.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga, faol yoki majhul nisbatga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

Grenlandiya - inuit tilida
Kallaalit Nunaat deb ataladi -
dunyodagi eng katta orol va
Shimoliy qutbga eng yaqin quruqlik.
Uning ko'p qismi Shimoliy qutb
doirasi ustida, u yerda yozda quyosh
umuman botmaydi.

Grenlandiya 982 yilda Islandiyalik
viking Qizil Erik tomonidan
kashf qilingan. U boshqa odamlar u
yerga borishni xohlashi uchun uni
"Grenlandiya" (Yashil yurt) deb
atagan.

Grenlandiya juda sovuq iqlimga ega
- kuchli qor bo'ronlari va qishki
harorat minus 35°C gacha. Hatto
yozda ham shimolda harorat faqat
3-4°C ga yetadi.

Grenlandiyada deyarli daraxt yoki o't
yo'q, u yerda juda kam hayvon
turlarini topish mumkin, lekin orol
atrofidagi dengizlarda tyulen va
kitlar ko'p.

Ulkan muz qatlami orolning deyarli
85% ini qoplaydi. Ba'zi joylarda muz
qatlami 3 km dan qalin. Eriyotgan
muz muz qatlami chekkalarida
muzliklar hosil qiladi. Biroq,
so'nggi yillarda olimlar muzliklar
kutilganidan ancha tez erimoqda
degan xulosaga kelishdi. Agar erish
shunchalik tez davom etsa, bu dunyo
okeanlari sathining ko'tarilishiga
va global ekologik falokatga sabab
bo'lishi mumkin.


JAVOBLAR:
  1 doesn't set (present simple,
    fakt)
  2 was discovered (MAJHUL - 'by
    Erik')
  3 called (past simple, faol)
  4 has (present simple)
  5 reaches (present simple)
  6 has (present simple)
  7 covers (present simple)
  8 have noticed (present perfect -
    'in recent years')
  9 are melting (present
    continuous - hozir)
  10 continues (1-tur shart: 'if'
    + present)


⚠ MAJHUL FAQAT 2 - 'discovered BY
Erik the Red'.


⚠ 'THE INUIT':

  = inuitlar (eskimoslar).


⚠ 'THE CLOSEST':

  = eng yaqin.


⚠ 'AD':

  = Anno Domini - milodiy.


⚠ 'A CLIMATE':

  = iqlim.


⚠ 'AS LOW AS':

  = ...gacha past.


⚠ 'A SEAL':

  = tyulen.


⚠ 'A SHEET OF ICE':

  = muz qatlami.


⚠ 'THAN EXPECTED':

  = kutilganidan.


⚠ 'THE LEVEL':

  = sath.
